questions.text: I understand the objectives and purpose of the Acme ERP program.
I am aware of how my role will be affected by the changes being introduced.
I trust that leadership is making good decisions about this change.
I feel confident I will have the skills and knowledge to do my job effectively with the new system.
I believe this change will ultimately benefit my team and our work.
I will have enough time during my normal workday to actually learn the new system.
It feels like we are constantly being asked to change how we work.
I am confident my area will get the same support and timing as everyone else.
I have a way to raise questions or concerns and actually be heard.
I have had the opportunity to provide input or feedback on the changes that affect my area.
What is your biggest question or concern about the program right now?

comms_plan.distribution: Email link via managers; QR poster in break rooms for frontline staff
comms_plan.reminders: Day 3 and day 6; survey open 8 business days
comms_plan.anonymity_statement: Responses are anonymous. Results are reported at group level only; groups with fewer than 5 responses are never reported.
comms_plan.results_feedback: You-said/we-heard summary to all respondents within 1 week of close; 2-3 named actions with owners; next wave's invite opens with what changed.
